mapper.insert: INSERT INTO check_out_requests(elderly_id, bed_id, phone_number, check_in_date, check_out_date, checkout_reason, checkout_type, approval_status, approval_time, approval_person) VALUES (#{elderlyId}, #{bedId}, #{phoneNumber}, #{checkInDate}, #{checkOutDate}, #{checkoutReason}, #{checkoutType}, #{approvalStatus}, #{approvalTime}, #{approvalPerson})
mapper.select: SELECT r.request_id, r.elderly_id, e.name, r.bed_id, r.phone_number, r.check_in_date, r.check_out_date, r.checkout_reason, r.checkout_type, r.approval_status, r.approval_time, r.approval_person FROM check_out_requests r LEFT JOIN elderly_info e ON r.elderly_id = e.elderly_id;
